Adapter unavailability blocks execution but not review.
approval_check_policy: Guardian packet and exact operator approval receipt are checked separately.
Guardian packet may exist for review while operator approval receipt remains missing.
component_simulation_policy: Validate delivery facts, invoice artifact, email package, Coupa package, approvals, covenant, secret refs, adapters, and final readback.
Missing component refs block the simulated run.
doctrine: No send, submit, browser, secret reveal, approval execution, or payment write occurs.
Blocked and missing states include how_to_fix.
dry_run_policy: Each step says whether it would be part of future execution.
would_run does not mean executed now.
Readiness is reported as ready, blocked, or missing.
external_action_boundary: No credentials or raw bodies are used.
final_readback_policy: Final readback target can be modeled only.
Completion claim is blocked without receipts.
harness.next_safe_move: Run this harness before any future action-capable invoice adapter; use the missing list to plan the next lane.
proof_check_policy: Proof checks report available/stale/missing proof refs.
Future send/submit/payment receipts remain missing in v0.
source_run_package_policy: Use the Invoice Delivery Run Package Assembler as source shape.
Treat component refs as metadata/readback refs only.
Unsupported or absent run package fails closed.

invoice_delivery_dry_run_blockers.condition: No source run package ref is present.
Guardian or operator approval proof is missing.
invoice_delivery_dry_run_blockers.next_safe_move: Create approval packet and future receipt.

invoice_delivery_dry_run_blockers.condition: Protected secret ref is missing if future Coupa login is required.
Email send adapter is missing or future-gated.
invoice_delivery_dry_run_blockers.next_safe_move: Build gated send adapter after proof/approval rails.

invoice_delivery_dry_run_blockers.condition: Coupa browser/submit adapter is missing or future-gated.
Required proof or receipt is missing.
invoice_delivery_dry_run_blockers.next_safe_move: Attach proof refs or future receipts.

invoice_delivery_dry_run_blockers.condition: Dry-run attempts to claim completion without receipts.

invoice_delivery_dry_run_blockers.next_safe_move: Ask for a scoped run package ref.

next_safe_move: Use the dry-run report to choose the next missing rail: artifact/proof, approval, email adapter, Coupa adapter, or payment receipt.
operator_summary: OpenClaw can now dry-run the Capital Hilton invoice delivery package and report ready steps, blocked steps, missing proofs, missing approvals, missing adapters, and next fixes without executing.
